h: Yahaya Bello says he will beat Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan 'overwhelmingly' in Kogi Central
p: Former Kogi Governor Yahaya Bello, who plans to contest the Kogi Central senatorial seat in 2027, has claimed his political reach far exceeds that of the sitting senator, Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan.
body: Former Kogi State Governor Yahaya Bello has said he will win the Kogi Central senatorial seat in the 2027 elections overwhelmingly, describing the incumbent, Senator Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan, as politically junior to him.

In an interview published on Friday, 20 November 2026, Bello reportedly said his political influence in Kogi State is far greater than that of any other politician. Asked whether nearly four years out of elective office had reduced his standing, he said the break had actually added to his popularity.
He also claimed he would not need to spend his own money on the campaign, saying residents had started contributing to it.
Akpoti-Uduaghan currently represents Kogi Central in the Senate. Her response to his remarks was not included in the reports.
more: Bello is running for the Kogi Central Senate seat.
He says he will win overwhelmingly.
Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan is the sitting senator.
